meta.name: high-end-visual-design
meta.description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页设计拥有高端品牌质感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成的设计摆脱廉价感、更像专业工作室出品。
copy.tagline_en: Make web designs feel premium and agency-crafted
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI-generated designs to look expensive and professional.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 生成网页界面代码时会按高端设计机构的标准执行:指定字体、间距、阴影、双层嵌套卡片结构和自定义缓动动效,并屏蔽 Inter、灰色 1px 边框、线性过渡等常见默认样式。
howto.when: 当你要它设计或生成网站、落地页、UI 组件代码时接管,先按内容从风格和版式原型里各选一种再动手。原文未写明确触发词。

say.text: 帮我做一个 AI SaaS 的落地页,要那种高端设计机构的视觉风格
say.note: 它会先选风格和版式原型再写代码

say.text: 用 React 和 Tailwind 重做卡片区,别用 Inter 和灰边框
say.note: 卡片套用双层嵌套,过渡换成自定义缓动

say.text: 给导航栏加悬浮玻璃胶囊样式,汉堡按钮点开要变成 X
say.note: 展开菜单用错峰上滑和玻璃遮罩

howto.what_en: Claude designs web UI as a high-end agency: choosing specific fonts, spacing, shadows, nested cards and custom cubic-bezier motion, while blocking generic defaults like Inter, gray 1px borders and linear transitions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to design or build a website or UI layout — landing pages, dashboards, components — anything where visual style matters.

say_en.text: Build a landing page for an AI SaaS with that high-end agency look.
say_en.note: It rolls a style and layout archetype first.

say_en.text: Rebuild this card section in React + Tailwind, no Inter, no gray borders.
say_en.note: Applies the Double-Bezel nested card structure.

say_en.text: Add a floating glass pill navbar and a hamburger that morphs into an X.
say_en.note: Uses staggered mask reveal and custom easing.
